name: Fully Customizable Pet Collar with Text!

captions.detailed: This 3D model presents a thin, circular pet collar featuring a small split gap on one side to allow flexibility. On the outer circumference near the split, there is a small raised rectangular clasp or catch mechanism with a horizontal slot. A separate, small curved segment is printed in the center of the ring, designed to slide into the clasp as a locking pin.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric, 3D-printable pet collar with an adjustable radius, width, and thickness. The collar should feature a split ring design with an integrated outer catch slot and a separate curved locking pin that fits into the catch.
captions.factory: The design is built around a main 'ring' module created by subtracting a smaller cylinder from a larger one. A 'ring_seg' helper module uses an intersection of a ring and a cube to generate curved segments. The main collar assembly combines the ring, cylindrical text using the write library, and a ring segment with a slot cut out of it, all sliced by a thin cube to form the break gap. A separate locking pin is rendered in the center using the 'ring_seg' module with customized box angle parameters.
